== Summary ==
People in an Oktoberfest beer tent in Munich on 26 September 2019, on the European trip after the [[2019 World Championship]] (Bochum, Germany, 20–22 September 2019). Posted with the caption "Welcome to beer country".

* '''Event:''' [[2019 World Championship]] (trip after the event)
* '''Camera timestamp:''' 2019:09:26 13:50:41 (EXIF; camera clock not verified)
* '''Date posted:''' 2019-09-26
